items.title: Kernel-lane Windows local clone recovery
items.deferred_reason: Single-agent mode active. Local Archivist surface only until repo state clean and next safe action explicit.

context.root_cause: Windows S:\kernel-lane became untrusted due to NTFS/file-lock/stale git index issues during attempted reclone. Original blocker involved old colon-named files from git history; current GitHub HEAD no longer contains colon-named files. Remaining issue is local Windows worktree/index/lock corruption, not a sync infrastructure failure.

steps: 1. Close Cursor / VS Code / file watchers.
2. Ensure no shell is inside S:\kernel-lane.
3. Fresh clone kernel-lane into a brand-new timestamped path under S:\.
4. Verify: Test-Path .git = True, git rev-parse --short HEAD matches origin/main, git status --short is empty.
6. Do not delete old backups until fresh clone is verified.
